title: Moeteledipele yo o Tlhomilweng wa Setšhaba
intro: Mo nakong ya kgwetlho e kgolo le go itlhoboga mo bathong, go ne ga dirwa go tlhomiwa ga bomodimo. Motho yono, yo kwa tshimologong a neng a tlhokomologilwe ke batho ba le bantsi, o ne a tlhophiwa ke Allah gore a etelele setšhaba pele kgatlhanong le mmaba yo o boitshegang. Kgang ya bone ke bosupi jwa maatla a tumelo le botlhale jo bo ka fa morago ga taelo ya bomodimo, e bontsha gore boeteledipele jwa boammaaruri ga se ka metlha bo fitlhelwang mo mafelong a a solofetsweng.
clues: Ke tlhophilwe ke Allah go nna moeteledipele wa batho ba me fa ba ne ba batla mmusi go lwa mo ntlheng ya Gagwe.
Batho ba me kwa tshimologong ba ne ba belaela go tlhomiwa ga me, ba ikutlwa gore ba bangwe ba ne ba tshwanelega thata ka ntlha ya khumo ya bone kgotsa losika lwa bone.
Sesupo sa boeteledipele jwa me jo bo siameng e ne e le go busediwa ga letlole le le boitshepo, le le neng le na le masalela a baporofeti ba ba fetileng, le le neng la tlisa kagiso.
Ke ne ka etelela mophato wa me pele go ya kwa nokeng, koo ke neng ka leka kutlo ya bone ka go ba thibela go nwa metsi a a fetang sekopo se le sengwe.
Le fa palo ya batho ba ba neng ba nna ba nitame morago ga teko e ne e le nnye, re ne ra lebana le motlhabani yo o nonofileng le masole a bone.
Ka fa tlase ga taolo ya me, mosha mongwe wa mo sesoleng sa me, yo e neng e se motlhabani yo o tumileng, o ne a lebana le mmampodi yo o boitshegang wa mmaba yono ka bopelokgale mme a mo fenya.

trial.label: Teko/Tiragalo
options: Go tlhomiwa jaaka moeteledipele kgatlhanong le seganka
trial.answer: Go tlhomiwa jaaka moeteledipele kgatlhanong le seganka

outcome.label: Botso
options: Go ne ga tlhomiwa bogosi jo bo nang le khumo e e seng kana ka sepe le maatla.
Batho ba ne ba nwela morwalela o mogolo.
Mofenyi wa mmaba o ne a fenngwa, mme Allah o ne a naya phenyo.
Komelelo e kgolo e ne ya bogisa lefatshe ka dingwaga di le dintsi.
Moeteledipele o ne a mediwa ke sebopiwa se segolo.
outcome.answer: Mofenyi wa mmaba o ne a fenngwa, mme Allah o ne a naya phenyo.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
